name: @aletheia-works/formicarium
description: Run unmodified x86-64 Linux CLI programs in the browser and Node.js on the paludarium WebAssembly emulator

scripts.test:browser: bun node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test tests/browser/probe.spec.ts tests/browser/interactive.spec.ts tests/browser/aube-1645.spec.ts tests/browser/pitchfork-basic.spec.ts
scripts.build: bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && bun .build/scripts/emit.js
scripts.typecheck: bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.test:unit: bun test tests/package/errors.test.js tests/package/public.test.js tests/package/validation.test.js tests/package/state.test.js tests/package/protocol.test.js tests/package/lifecycle.test.js tests/package/guest-io.test.js
scripts.test:light: bun run test:unit && bun run test:tooling-bun && bun run test:node-unit && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/release/*.test.js tests/ci/verification.test.js .build/tests/tooling/publication-*.test.js
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && bun node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test
scripts.test:node-unit: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-skip-pattern="real Node |real generated loader mutation|a real guest run through" tests/package/core.test.js tests/package/worker-execution.test.js tests/package/node-api.test.js tests/package/node-worker.test.js tests/package/runner-ready.test.js tests/package/types.test.js tests/package/tooling.test.js tests/package/coverage.test.js tests/package/guest-validation.test.js tests/package/session-fixture.test.js tests/package/session-reservation.test.js tests/package/session-public.test.js tests/package/install-catalog.test.js tests/package/install-transfer.test.js tests/package/install-archive.test.js tests/package/install-lifecycle.test.js tests/package/install-public.test.js tests/package/install-hash-regression.test.js tests/package/command-parse.test.js tests/package/command-dispatch.test.js tests/package/command-public.test.js tests/package/session-input.test.js
scripts.showcase:unit: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='showcase/scripts/**' --test-coverage-lines=80 showcase/tests/runner-ready.test.ts showcase/tests/config.test.ts showcase/tests/resolve.test.ts showcase/tests/acquire.test.ts showcase/tests/archive.test.ts showcase/tests/build-key.test.ts showcase/tests/build.test.ts showcase/tests/reuse.test.ts showcase/tests/catalog.test.ts showcase/tests/pack.test.ts showcase/tests/candidate.test.ts showcase/tests/boundary.test.ts showcase/tests/mode.test.ts showcase/tests/workflow.test.ts
